description: Export a live event's guest list — free RSVPs, guest-list adds, comps and paid tickets — as a downloadable CSV (name, email, phone, category, ticket class, plus-ones, checked-in, note, source) and return a download link. Cancelled/refunded tickets left out; staff only with include_staff. Optional category filter. Requires event_id; you must be a host. Read-only.
name: export_guest_list_csv
title: Export Guest List CSV
